about: Where every text comes from. Each source is downloaded from the organization that publishes it, pinned to a commit, release or dated file, and checked against the SHA-256 recorded here before it is converted; a download that doesn't match stops ingest. See res/SOURCES.md.

kjv.title: King James Version
kjv.publishedNote: eBible.org's "Last updated" date for the release that was checked; the file is replaced in place, so a new release changes the checksum.
kjv.license: Public domain (outside the UK, where the Crown's letters patent apply)

bsb.title: Berean Standard Bible
bsb.publishedNote: The download's Last-Modified date for the file that was checked; the publisher replaces it in place, so a new release changes the checksum.
bsb.license: Public domain (dedicated April 30, 2023; berean.bible/terms.htm). Attribution appreciated, not required.

henry.title: Matthew Henry's Commentary on the Whole Bible
henry.organization: Christian Classics Ethereal Library (CCEL), Calvin University
henry.files: mhc1.xml, mhc2.xml, mhc3.xml, mhc4.xml, mhc5.xml, mhc6.xml
henry.publishedNote: Last-Modified date of the six volumes that were checked; CCEL replaces files in place.
henry.license: Public domain ("May be copied and distributed freely", in each volume). CCEL's site policy asks permission for republishing or commercial use.
